id: \bMy sister runs the Gym here. Don't expect to be able to beat her.
en: \bMy sister runs the Gym here. Don't expect to be able to beat her.
it: \bMia sorella dirige la Palestra di qui. Non illuderti di poterla battere.

id: \bI guess you're really strong. You may stand a chance. Use this to help you.
en: \bI guess you're really strong. You may stand a chance. Use this to help you.
it: \bA quanto pare sei davvero forte. Forse hai qualche possibilità. Usa questo per aiutarti.

id: \bYou beat my sister? Impressive, take this.
en: \bYou beat my sister? Impressive, take this.
it: \bHai battuto mia sorella? Notevole, prendi questo.

id: \bYou're challenging the Orange Crew? Good luck.
en: \bYou're challenging the Orange Crew? Good luck.
it: \bStai sfidando gli Orange Crew? Buona fortuna.
\bAnche se dubito che ce la farai.
